name: Gurosik's Berry Plantation
tagline: Gurosik's Berry Plantation – 345 Briggs Rd  North Augusta,SC 29860
description: In North Augusta, SC, Gurosik's Berry Plantation raises Strawberries, Blueberries, Blackberries, Corn, and Tomatoes on a independent farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring and summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
